blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The Cebu Provincial Sports Complex, which has remained unused for more than five years despite being declared complete in 2020, is expected to open in the first quarter of 2027, Capitol officials said. Gov. Pamela Baricuatro announced the target opening during a press conference on Wednesday, November 25, following questions raised […]...
